scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

provenance.generator: Astra developer plan selection + Sol developer elevation measurement + deterministic compilation
provenance.important_limit: Developer knows historical case context; this is not a blind target-model run.

agent_assumptions: Developer-assisted reconstruction from the original drawing, not target-model autonomous generation.
Room uses inferred from furniture; no textual room names visible.
Outer-perimeter reference and internal mid-wall references intentionally differ; source is a lightweight representative-plane model.
Partition endpoint junctions extended only through visible connecting wall bands to the chosen representative plane.
Interior doors use 2.1m assumed height and unknown operating state.
Doors/windows use raster-measured extents; about one source pixel (0.028m) localization uncertainty.
Exterior wall thickness / roof structural depth are not modeled.
4.5m source height follows the external elevation envelope. Ceiling/slab construction thickness and net clear height are unspecified.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: The elevations do not label finished floor level. Source floor z=0 is the lower facade outline; observed exterior door sill z=0.2 is retained without inventing a physical step.
Interior door heights and operating state are not supplied; 2.1m and unknown are explicit assumptions.
Window/door widths use the plan's measured pixels with about 0.03m uncertainty; elevation dimensions cross-check category and matching, not hidden endpoint replacement.
Developer example needs user review and independent working-model transfer; no autonomous or stability claim.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts
